description: A delegation an admitted turn installed (the entry's `grants[]`, with its revocation), as world-grants answers it.

main.description: Record key: the grant id (a hash of ["grant", principal, intent, ordinal], a derived id). The record's cid is the hash of the entry that installed it.

grantor.description: The principal whose authority the grant lends.

to.description: The grantee: a principal or an object id.

until.description: The last clock height it stands.
